title: FTX Owed Billions And Held A Fraction
hook: FTX owed billions and held a fraction of it.
question: Still keeping coins on an exchange?

scenes.narration: FTX owed its customers billions. When they finally looked, only a fraction was there.
Eight billion dollars of customer deposits. Missing.
scenes.label: simply gone

scenes.narration: This was a company valued at thirty-two billion dollars.
scenes.label: company valuation

scenes.narration: Five billion was pulled in seventy-two hours. Then withdrawals froze.
scenes.label: then the gates shut

scenes.narration: Sam Bankman-Fried got twenty-five years. Still keeping your coins on an exchange?
